set.body: Read-only follow-up from normalization-budget repair bd-01M478XB9V86YE7SR8BGH457ND. EventResponse.prepare UnitPeak already caps reference samples but calls PulseResponse.at at every reference lag. A trapezoid pulse or nested blocked kernel can multiply bounded reference samples by bounded pulse offsets into enormous work; ceil responseSpan/referenceStep can also create a non-finite final lag from finite inputs. Reuse the delivered normalization work estimator or an equivalent declared policy, account for actual exact primitives/piecewise/fallback work and nested transforms, refuse before evaluation using EventResponseNormalizationError, preserve reference-step and per-basis peak conventions and all numerical parity. Include callbacks proving pre-evaluation refusal, boundary/overflow tests on JVM+JS, and safe mutation evidence. Source inspection only; no unsafe composed work executed.
set.title: Bound composed pulse-response normalization work and reference times
